changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > CC RECALL makes the MIDI tracks send their pattern’s CC values at once.
It acts after a pattern reload, a pattern change (also while playing, in a chain or in song mode), a project load or STOP; stock waits for each track’s next trig.
Pitch bend and aftertouch go out as with the stock first trig. Unticked, MIDI output is stock.
The setting is not saved and starts unticked at every power-on.
Tested on a Digitakt I, alone and with FX Track.
